craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at sundered-varied shine — stain and shine in one breath throughout. Unthought-clear held; self-means (instrument kept reflexive). Rejected: (a) held→kept → killed: holding is active. Read aloud: THOUGHT-free, CLEAR-shin-ing … SELF it-SELF MADE the-MEANS.

lines: Thought-free, clear-shining — that Shambhu's making, held —
by no-difference, in self-making, self itself made the means.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avikalpasphuṭābhāsā sā sṛṣṭiḥ śāmbhavī matā | abhedenātmanirmāṇe svātmaiva karaṇīkṛtaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What creation holds unthought? → Unthought-clear creation held; self instrumented in self-making.
c1_essence: Unthought-clear held; self means in self-making.
